ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 60 percent high-intensity white pixels and 40 percent low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-medial portion of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the leading edges and perimeter, with significant high-contrast linear mottling and streaking intersecting the white field across the 2D plane.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with a defined base; approximate pixel angle of 40 degrees between the inner margins of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the right lobe trailing edge with varying pixel-amplitudes. The left lobe trailing edge displays coarse, irregular peaks and valleys, partially obscured by the structural fold.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe displays a convex distal sweep. The left lobe displays a truncated trajectory due to a significant inward fold of the outer margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, high-contrast, textured cluster of raised off-white/tan pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) localized on the superior edge of the folded left lobe. Smaller clusters detected at the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surfaces of both lobes in vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural fold/deformation of the left lobe margin. Heavy barnacle encrustation on the upper-left perimeter.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique set of four parallel, dark, curved linear marks located in the lower-central quadrant of the left lobe.
